name: context-consultant
description: Build, manage, and improve the context that makes Hex's AI agents (Threads, Notebook Agent, Modeling Agent) accurate — endorsements, warehouse descriptions, workspace context, guides, and semantic models — then measure it with a dedicated eval engine that authors and runs eval suites, sources cases from real usage, and gates changes in a hex context preview. Publish via GitHub sync or the Hex CLI. Routes to the specific workflow instead of running full setup each time.
